name: High Tide
summary: Outline buttons that fill with a sloshing wave, splash when pressed and refill as progress
about: Three outline call-to-action buttons. On hover a gradient liquid sloshes up past the top and settles, and the label turns white exactly at the waterline. A press squashes the button, splashes droplets out of the top, drains and refills the liquid as a progress bar while bubbles boil, then bounces with a done label and a bigger splash. Use them as main buttons on landing pages, shops and portfolios.
how: Hover, Tab to or tap a button: the liquid springs up with waves, the label turns white at the waterline and bubbles drift up.
Press: the button squashes, then droplets splash out of the top and a ring spreads from your press.
The liquid drains and refills like a progress bar while the bubbles boil and the label says what it is doing.
Done: the button bounces, splashes again and shows a done label with a tick; the line underneath confirms it.
Then the liquid drains away and the original label comes back.
